name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tab selector with underline (default) and pill styles per theme; panels switch via CSS.

variants.name: underline
variants.description: Accent underline on the active tab; omit data-uifa-variant.

variants.name: pill
variants.description: Soft accent pill on the active tab.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant; the closed data-uifa-variant table.

slots.name: tab
slots.description: Tab label wired to its panel via the native radio.

docs: Radio inputs keep selection and arrow-key navigation JavaScript-free. Each tab's `value` must match its panel's `data-panel`; the stylesheet ships the preview/history pair, so extend the panel-switch selectors when you add tabs. Style comes from the theme: underline reads formal, pill reads casual.
